name: update_memory
description: Updates persistent memory. Store one fact per line in compact format (e.g. 'likes spicy food'). Append never duplicates an exact line. Remove and patch require the exact line content to match — provide the complete line text verbatim. Remove deletes one exact line. Patch replaces the exact matched line with replacement.

target_file.description: Which memory file to update. 'user.md' is for user preferences, facts, and tasks. 'soul.md' is for core agent persona.

update_mode.description: How to update: 'append' adds content, 'remove' deletes matching lines, 'patch' finds a line and replaces it with replacement.

content.description: The line content for append/remove/patch. For append: the new line to add. For remove: the exact line to delete. For patch: the exact line to find and replace.

replacement.description: Required for patch mode. The text to replace the matched line with.
